html_description:
Bound by Soft Gate and Harbor Light

Glass Holding is starving Soft Hour. Hale's gray coats turn sealed charts into pharmacy squeeze and berth denial. Elena Voss and Julian Kane — already each other's — keep the basement clinic open under Holding paper, while Soft Gate converts medical history into a weapon.

Elena still counts exits when the door scrapes wrong. Julian stills his hands when collectors smile. Mira's name on the chalk board is a target Holding can read.

Soft Hour is not a romance backdrop — it is a triage floor under siege, and love is the ledger line they will not surrender. Soft Gate leverage is named without spoiling the full mechanism.

Harbor Light Book Four — established couple, dark mafia stakes, earned HEA. Soft Hour still opens. The price stays visible.

What you will find inside
  • Established couple — Elena and Julian (steel / dark), already bound
  • Glass Holding as system — protocol, pharmacy routes, loyalty seals
  • Soft Gate pressure — sealed history as leverage (revealed in-story)
  • Slow-burn heat — proximity, almost-touch, trust through behavior
  • Earned HEA — Soft Hour still opens; the price stays visible

If you crave dark mafia romance where love costs something real — start reading tonight.

Scroll up and grab your copy.
